analysis.reason: RSI 34.4에서 41.0으로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 시도, MACD 히스토그램도 -3.5475에서 -2.1744로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호. 그러나 SMA5($344.61)가 SMA20($375.37) 하회, SMA50($416.64) 하회 등 단기·중기 이동평균선이 모두 저항으로 작용하며 추세 전환 확신 부족. ADX 32.0으로 뚜렷한 추세는 있으나 -DI(40.5)가 +DI(23.8)보다 우위인 점은 하락 압력 잔존 시사. 거래량비 0.16으로 매우 위축된 상태에서 방향성 판단 어려움. 따라서 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold from 34.4 to 41.0, and MACD histogram improves from -3.5475 to -2.1744, signaling potential bottoming. However, short- and mid-term moving averages (SMA5 at $344.61 below SMA20 at $375.37, and below SMA50 at $416.64) act as resistance, lacking conviction for a trend reversal. ADX at 32.0 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (40.5) is stronger than +DI (23.8), suggesting residual downward pressure. Very low trading volume ratio of 0.16 makes directional judgment difficult. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($349.22) vs SMA5/20/50 ($344.61/$375.37/$416.64) - Above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/50, confirming entry into a weak zone.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($416.50/$402.12) - Below long-term moving averages, indicating a continuation of the weak trend.
· 52-week position (34.9%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.4→41.0) - Attempting to exit oversold territory, but upward momentum is weak.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.5475→-2.1744) - Improving, but signals for a weak trend reversal are still faint.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $375.37) - Trading around the mid-band, indicating a lack of direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($331.92) - Below SMA200, expected to act as a key support level.
· Swing resistance ($350.45) - Above short-term SMA5 but within resistance zone; a breakout could signal a bullish reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Range-bound) - Continued sideways movement without a clear trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.16x) - Very subdued volume, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) - While RSI shows recovery and MACD improvement signals exist, uncertainty in direction due to moving average resistance and lack of volume warrants a wait-and-see approach.
